restaurantName: Marco Pierre White's New York Italian
bio: Treat your guest to a day out in the city with this afternoon tea treat at Marco's New York Italian Something unique and new with a trusted brand and a whole lot of experience behind it, Marco's New York Italian is the latest in the Marco Pierre White empire to take London by storm.  Offering quality, fresh ingredients and a winning atmosphere, there isn't a better place for you and your loved one to enjoy an afternoon tea in the city. Sit back and relax as you are served a delicious selection of sandwiches, cakes, and scones all accompanied by a stunning choice of teas.
pageTitle: Marco Pierre White's New York Italian
